evidence_quotes: demolição de imóveis construídos em área de proteção de mananciais
sem as autorizações ambientais municipais e estaduais (as estaduais são necessárias porque se trata de área de mananciais)
rationale: The TJSP decision concerns an enforcement action ordering the demolition of buildings constructed in an irregular/clandestine subdivision within a watershed protection zone (área de proteção de mananciais) without required municipal and state environmental permits, alongside restitution to lot buyers. Under the mananciais-calibrated rule, Brazilian watershed protection (área de proteção de mananciais) decisions are classified as WATER under environmental_protection. Under strict_service_access_label, because the dispute involves land-use/demolition enforcement in a mananciais zone without direct water utility service access or direct water abstraction/pollution adjudication, it is marked UNCERTAIN, and involves_connection_or_informal_settlement is false.
